# User Interface

The User Interface layer of docturnal handles the app registration page and setup page.

## Overview

This layer is responsible for providing the user interface for the Docturnal GitHub App. It includes the registration page where users can create the app and the setup page where they can configure the app's settings.

## Responsibilities

- Serves the app registration page on `localhost:8790`.
- Manages the optional settings page for the app.

## How it works

The User Interface layer consists of several files:

- `app/scripts/register.mjs`: Serves the app registration page.
- `app/src/setup.ts`: Manages the optional settings page.

### App registration page

The registration page is served by the `register.mjs` script. When a user creates the app on GitHub, they are redirected to this page. The script serves the registration page and displays the app's credentials.

### Setup page

The setup page is managed by the `setup.ts` script. It provides an optional settings page for the app. The page saves the browser's time zone as soon as it loads, so closing it gives midnight in the user's own time zone. The settings are saved and can be used to configure the app's behavior.

## Configuration

This layer does not read any settings, environment variables, or configuration files.
